plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero for capital preservation.
Sell high-beta names like METU, MSFU, MUU, and PLTU to reduce overall risk.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces exposure to volatile assets.
It aims for a more stable portfolio with lower drawdown potential.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and high-beta exposure, aiming for lower drawdowns. Expect reduced volatility but also limited upside potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Reduce leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to a small 0.5% each.
Trim high-beta names (METU, MSFU, MUU, PLTU) to reduce overall concentration.
Buy ERY at 4% as a strong scanner long setup to add quality growth.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a small cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality scanner setup. Expect moderate volatility and growth potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the mandate while maintaining exposure.
Add to METU, MSFU, MUU, PLTU, and SPAL to increase exposure to high-score names and leveraged ETFs.
Add to SOXL to increase leveraged semiconductor exposure.
Buy ERY at 6% as a strong scanner long setup, leaning into growth.
This plan stretches for growth, using leverage and concentration in high-scoring setups.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-beta names, concentrating in high-scoring setups. Be aware of significantly higher drawdown potential and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30% for enhanced income.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero to reduce volatility.
Sell high-beta single names (METU, MSFU, MUU, PLTU) to near zero.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
It aims to park cash for yield, acting as a cash-like income strategy.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It heavily favors income ETFs and broad index exposure, cutting almost all leveraged and high-beta names. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in market downturns.
